all_words.explanation: Terminology is the set of specialised terms a field uses, which is exactly what jargon is, so the link is semantic.
An avalanche is a mass of snow sliding down a mountain and has nothing to do with specialised language.
A lexicon is the vocabulary of a language or field, so it belongs to the same thematic area as jargon.
A pineapple is a tropical fruit and is unrelated to the vocabulary of any profession.
An acronym is a shortened form built from initial letters, a common feature of specialist jargon.
A blanket is a bed covering and has no connection to specialised language.

explanation: The associated words all describe the vocabulary and shortened forms that specialist groups use, while the others belong to nature, food, and household objects.
